vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At frozen HEAD ebf892c45b80246570b31a3d86a392c4caa8e1c6, callbacks.signIn applies serverConfig.auth.emailVerificationRequired and user.emailVerified only inside if (credentials). The OAuth path skips that branch, retains the explicit TODO that OAuth users can sign in while email verification is enabled, and reaches return true. This is a conditional CWE-287 policy bypass when EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED=true and a configured OAuth/OIDC provider supplies an email without enforcing ownership.

atomic_bic.evidence: Targeted -S searches for both emailVerificationRequired and the OAuth-trust TODO identify only 93049e864ae6d281b60c23dee868bca3f585dd4a as their first write in apps/web/server/auth.ts. Its diff introduces the verification policy, the credentials-only guard, and the acknowledged OAuth exception together; it is the smallest surviving public-history object that creates this flaw.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: Immediate parent aae3ef17eccf0752edb5ce5638a58444ccb6ce3a has the OAuth signIn path but no emailVerificationRequired policy or emailVerified gate. The bypass cannot exist before the policy introduced by the BIC.
